text.p: Palestinian shares closed unchanged in the Palestine Securities Exchange's (PSE) 17th weekly trading session on Tuesday, officials said.

PSE General-Manager Safwan Bataina said 37,116 shares worth 59,457 Jordanian dinars ($83,742) were traded during Tuesday's session. A report by the exchange showed 10 of the 24 companies listed on the exchange traded shares.
"Share prices maintained their level," Bataina said.
The stock exchange opened in February.
Bataina said the exchange plans to move from one to two weekly trading sessions starting in July but an index will only be published after the shares of 15 companies are traded.
